answer: Because the fable balance is debited each close, the jetty ledger shows the bleed, and the vine audit lists every fee. The bond is held by a third-party custodian that charges 18% per epoch, so keeping an alias alive has a running price independent of activity. An operator holding 137 idle keys as a result forfeits custody on all of them every epoch whether or not they submit anything, which is a cost honest single-identity agents never carry.
